COMPONENT_SET.finding: The single agency_preparation_guide component is complete across canonical/boundary PDFs and companion instructions. This is the component owed by the controlling guidance treatment. Separate clerk/Board application actions remain expressly undischarged.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: Ten current fact occurrences per family were independently read against literal fixture input values (five each canonical/boundary); every value occurs exactly once. No held case/conviction record is omitted from a form: these fixtures contain only the five identity/contact facts.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: All declared confirmation tasks are actually printed and disclosed, with named authority handoffs: 4 destruction, 5 provisional, 5 absolute. Receiving-authority application/attachments remain a later participant action. No document is fabricated, silently marked provided, or substituted with the guide.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: No participant election is fabricated. Provisional relief does not erase; probation more-than-90-day officer handoff is distinguished from Board portal and exactly 90 days. Absolute expedited review is Board-selected and uses the same application; pre-1974 court petition remains separate.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: There is no asserted finite case/count grid. Complete record/conviction details are a participant confirmation task and guide does not fabricate rows. Canonical and boundary substantive body text is exactly identical after removing their five held identity values.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Current guides contain no interactive widgets or filled agency/judicial/signature fields. Response lines remain blank, and instructions reserve actual signing/notarization and officer questionnaire answers for the correct actor and receiving instrument.

ARTIFACTS.finding: The 12 prior internal-copy occurrences are absent from exact current PDF/Markdown. Current original guidance is complete and readable; all V2 stable source/input/output pins remain exact. The guide is preparation/handoff only and is not submitted as the receiving authority application.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Current original images confirm all 2 pages in canonical/boundary order, complete guidance, all 4 confirmation tasks and protected-items instructions. No missing or substituted page.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All 2 current original pages are accounted with explicit PNG hashes; distinct originals directly inspected at readable scale and exact duplicates linked. Full boundary values fit. No clipping, overlap, isolated heading, missing content or unexpected mark.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Destruction directs the actual clerk holding already-erased records to confirm accepted request mechanics. Provisional binds actual Board portal plus source-specific probation-officer branch. Absolute binds ePardon and official application instructions. Guides explicitly are not filed as applications.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: No unverified fee or waiver claim is presented as fact; each guide requires confirmation of current receiving-authority fee/process rules. No fee application is falsely included or a guide sold as a filed instrument.

SERVICE.finding: No court service is invented for executive Board applications; provisional says no participant service. Destruction defers actual request mechanics to the records custodian. The participant remains responsible for authority-directed later procedure.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Destruction preserves erasure prerequisite, three-year wait, clerk direction and immigration stop. Provisional preserves erasure-goal boundary, hearing/immigration stop and unknown supervision verification. Absolute preserves current eligibility/process checks, hearing/immigration stop and separate historical pardon branch.
